title: One Rod Change Doubled the Load on This Walkway
description:
Two steel walkways hung above the packed atrium of the Hyatt Regency in Kansas City. In July 1981 they fell.
We rebuild the walkways in 3D and walk the cause chain from the federal investigation: a connection that was weak from the start, a rod change during construction, and a review that never caught it.
Then the lab tests, the findings, and the rule that changed who designs a connection.

CHAPTERS

Sources: National Bureau of Standards, Investigation of the Kansas City Hyatt Regency Walkways Collapse; ASCE Civil Engineering magazine (2007, 2011).
Based on official investigation reports and published sources. 3D scenes are reconstructions, not actual footage.
